Overview

Microsoft 365, done properly

Microsoft 365 runs the email, files, meetings and security of millions of businesses. Set up well, it's secure, organised and easy to use. Set up poorly, files end up scattered, sharing is risky and staff use a fraction of what you pay for.

As a Microsoft Partner, we help you choose the right licences, set up and secure Microsoft 365 and Azure, roll out Copilot safely, add Teams calling, and build custom apps on Power Apps, SharePoint and Dynamics 365. Then we train your team and support you 24/7.

Who it's for

  • Businesses moving to Microsoft 365
  • Teams with messy file sharing
  • Organisations ready for Copilot
  • Eligible Australian charities

How it works

A typical rollout takes about 90 days

  1. Assessment

    We review your current licences, devices, data and security.

  2. Fixed quote

    The right plan for each user, with no paying for features you won't use.

  3. Rollout

    Setup, migration and security configured with minimal disruption.

  4. Training & support

    Your team learns the tools, and we stay on call 24/7.

Pricing

What affects the cost of Microsoft 365

  • Number of users and the Microsoft plan each needs
  • How much email and file data needs to move
  • Security requirements, devices and compliance needs
  • Whether you need custom apps, workflows or Copilot agents
  • Ongoing support and licence management

Every quote is itemised, in AUD or USD, and valid for 30 days.

Getting started

What we'll need from you

FAQ

Microsoft questions

Are you a Microsoft Partner?

Yes. EG Eloma is a Microsoft Partner.

Can you sell licences outside Australia?

Microsoft licensing is currently available to Australian clients only. Setup, development and support are available worldwide.

How long does a Microsoft 365 rollout take?

A typical rollout takes about 90 days, from free consultation and fixed quote through to build, training and ongoing management.

Can charities get Microsoft 365 for free?

Eligible Australian charities may get Microsoft 365 Business Basic free for up to 300 users, plus discounted Business Premium and an annual Azure credit grant. Microsoft sets eligibility, and we can check it for you.

Can you help us use Copilot?

Yes. We review permissions, roll out licences, train your team and build Copilot agents.

Do you support Microsoft 365 outside Australia?

Yes. Setup, development, training and support are available worldwide. Licence supply is for Australian clients.

Can you migrate us from Google Workspace?

Yes. We plan and run migrations of email, calendars and files.
